notes.title: Element4l UPDATE 1.2
notes.content:
Features:
* Mr. Smooth! - new help system, for those who are stuck at a certain point. You may ask for help after you lose 5 elements at a certain checkpoint

* Updated checkpoints

* Localization! - mtba

notes.title: Element4l update (24/5)
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented some from accessing the Prologue...

You can always access the tutorial levels by pressing new game, and selecting AIR, ICE or STONE.  Have fun!
